description:
Delete the harness demonstration suite, whose remaining cases re-prove properties owned elsewhere.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/harness_demo.rs` re-proves queries, blocking, cycle rejection and gates, which their domain, graph and gate tests own; its unique cases already have owners. `fast_docs_templates/main.rs` declares it, and `dev/TESTING.md` (`:86`, `:161`, `:166`, `:562`, `:615`, `:716`, `:747`) cites it as a worked example.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `harness_demo.rs` no longer exists, and `fast_docs_templates/main.rs` does not declare it.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each property it re-proved has an owning test elsewhere.
- [hard] REQ-03: `dev/TESTING.md` cites owning tests as worked examples where it cited the demonstration.
title: The harness demonstration suite is deleted
